name: Impeccable
description: Arah visual, hierarki, warna, aksesibilitas dan kualitas hasil.
source: Koleksi lokal pengguna; adaptasi panduan untuk Bantuin
guidance: Choose one visual direction appropriate to the audience. Preserve an existing brand. Define readable typography, deliberate spacing, contrast, keyboard focus and responsive behavior. Prefer purposeful composition over repeated generic cards. Respect manual colors and fonts. Verify desktop and mobile in bounded passes.

name: UI Craft
description: Form, state, layout dan aksesibilitas yang dapat diterapkan.
source: Koleksi lokal pengguna; adaptasi panduan untuk Bantuin
guidance: Model loading, empty, error, success, disabled and offline states. Use semantic forms, persistent labels, native keyboard controls and visible focus. Group related controls, disclose advanced options, and preserve input after failure. Keep touch targets at least 44px. Use existing tokens and one consistent icon system.

name: UI/UX Pro Max
description: Pencocokan jenis produk, tipografi, palet dan pola antarmuka.
source: Koleksi lokal pengguna; adaptasi panduan untuk Bantuin
guidance: Match the visual profile to the website type, users and primary action. Specify heading/body font roles, type scale, spacing, responsive layouts and semantic colors. Explain the recommendation and avoid adding unrelated features. Use accessible states and contrast; manual user choices remain authoritative.

name: Emil Design Engineering
description: Motion, detail komponen dan interaksi yang proporsional.
source: Koleksi lokal pengguna; adaptasi panduan untuk Bantuin
guidance: Use motion only when it clarifies a state or spatial relationship. Avoid animating frequent actions. Specify duration and easing, reduce exit duration where appropriate, honor prefers-reduced-motion, maintain focus and keyboard behavior, and explain hover/pressed/disabled states. Keep responsiveness and readable content ahead of decoration.

name: Webapp Testing
description: Panduan Playwright, alur kritis, screenshot dan isolasi fixture dari Anthropic.
guidance: Specify Playwright browser tests for the critical user journeys. Inspect the rendered interface before choosing selectors; prefer accessible roles and stable labels. Wait for visible application readiness rather than arbitrary delays or network-idle on polling pages. Cover validation, permissions, network errors, mobile widths and keyboard focus. Capture screenshots and browser errors. Use isolated test accounts and synthetic fixtures, clean them up, never claim tests passed until they run. Third-party helper scripts are not executed by Bantuin.

name: Anti-slop
description: Filter desain generik, konten rekaan dan interaksi tanpa fungsi.
guidance: Apply Anti-slop as a purpose test on the existing brand and locked user preferences. Explain major choices in layout, typography, color and motion. Build composition around real product content; avoid generic template sections and decoration without a purpose. Never invent testimonials, statistics, team identities, security claims or working features. Use specific action labels and real navigation targets. Specify responsive layouts, keyboard access, visible focus, contrast, reduced motion and truthful loading, empty and error states. Review design direction, purpose, identity and functional completeness before delivery; record actual checks and unresolved failures. Do not force new colors, fonts, themes or features, run the upstream installation wizard or execute third-party scripts.
